en: A color postcard showing a historic Ottoman-era stone mosque with a large gray dome and a tall, slender minaret, situated between later residential buildings along a street. The back of the postcard contains multilingual captions (Hungarian, German, English, Russian) identifying the site, along with standard postcard layout for address and stamp, printer and photographer credits, and a printed price in Hungarian forints.
